captureNotes: FERC generated tariff PDF renditions are not assumed to be byte duplicates. Two distinct November 9 renditions for ER27-454 and ER26-3515 were captured, alongside the submitter’s source files. Other generated renditions and unsupported files are identified separately on the relevant file lists.

From about 22:00 ET on November 10, the public eLibrary returned HTTP 500 for 62 of 100 related-docket file-list requests. For the other 38 the metadata was available, but the normal public download did not yield a file. Nine signer-hosted copies were retrieved independently. The 12 show-cause and rehearing sheets had already been reconciled before these errors.
